A '''battle''' was fought on [[New Bakstre]]. This battle was one of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces in the battle were led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Traavis]].
